articles.title: The Push to Free a Princeton Scientist From ICE Detention Is Growing
articles.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detained a Princeton University doctoral candidate on Nov. 19 at an airport in Arlington, Virginia. Her colleagues, classmates, and lawmakers are calling for her immediate release ahead of Thanksgiving Weekend. Eva Yi Xie, a Chinese national, was detained at the Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport as she departed from an annual conference of the Society for Neuroscience. articles.title: Trump Administration Unveils New Tariffs for China, the European Union, and More
articles.summary: The Trump Administration on Wednesday proposed sweeping new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including China and the European Union , threatening to reignite global trade tensions. China is set to be hit with the highest rate, facing tariffs of up to 20% on most covered goods. The rate could potentially rise to 40% if Beijing fails to honor the trade truce agreed upon between Beijing and Washington last year. articles.summary: In an era that’s seen the K-drama industry shift focus toward more stories of suspense, thriller, and crime , the romantic comedy Love in Disguise marks a return to a familiar K-drama trope.
